== Description ==

'''E-30i''', is one of the many enteties you may encounter in [[Section E]], it being the prime variant of [[E-30]]

== Mechanic ==
it will have a chance to spawn once [[E-30]] despawns, if it does spawn it will appear behind the void wall and begin rushing to the main room at a moderate speed, filling the player's screen with static, upon breaking the door, it will fall back, despawning past Voidwall.

== Strategies ==

Since '''E-30i''' doesn't give any warning to hint that it spawned, you will need to keep your ears open and hide immediately after you hear him.
